notes: OSM-derived route with an explicitly image-guided correction of the lower outer bend. Outside the corrected interval the original OSM candidate coordinates are retained exactly, with ODbL attribution; these pixels are not independent image observations. Ten native-image centre controls replace the old lower chicane that crosses the visible curb/apron. The correction follows pinned June2024 PNOA orthophotography, not operator diagram coordinates. Operator illustration identifies the route configuration only. Both OSM and PNOA attribution are retained. Source configuration, travel direction and georeferencing remain draft; no nominal dimensions, timing position or banking are fitted.

sources.notes: Road height is sampled from the existing approximately 22 m terrain raster and compressed to a 0.5 m interpolation tolerance relative to those samples; this is not road-surface survey accuracy. Station distances use the midpoint of corresponding border stations, not an official length measurement. There is no saved GPS start gate; the simulation begins at the first trace coordinate. Curbs and bend labels are geometry-based illustrations, not extracted from imagery or verified real curb locations; widths, heights and colours are assumed. Banking is unknown and assumed zero. Source border coordinates retain their separate feature-level licence; invalid cross-sections are interpolated. Imagery is an external display resource subject to provider terms; no image bytes are included.

measurement.note: Draft paired road limits from52 sparse image cross-sections plus23 directly re-read native-pixel curb controls outside the lower-bend correction, and11 newly read lower-bend cross-sections. Existing fitted edge curves are resampled against the corrected source route; resampled and compacted controls are not independent observations. The old lower chicane is excluded in favour of the continuous paved outer bend identified in operator imagery. Limits follow visible pavement, curbs and white paint where distinguishable; pale inner route, shadows, barrier openings and apron joins remain estimates. The broad pit-exit/apron interval near lower-bend station45 includes an inferred outer join; it is not an independent measured boundary. No nominal length, width or GPS timing is fitted. Source route and direction remain draft; curbs illustrative, terrain estimated and banking unknown.

borderInference.note: Road-border estimates reconstructed from complete pairs of sparse image-edge measurements. Each pair defines its own road section; the original trace is preserved and constrains station displacement and route order. Linear intervals, junction openings and curbs remain estimates, not surveyed racing limits. Every saved edge station and anchor requires pinned-image coverage during authoring. No automatic evidence scores are claimed.
